audience: businesses that message customers on WhatsApp with AiSensy

useCases.title: Check which WhatsApp templates are approved or rejected
useCases.text: The AI lists templates with language, status (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED), category and text, and opens one to show the rejection reason.

useCases.title: Check how a campaign performed
useCases.text: The AI reads daily sent, delivered, read and failed counts and credit usage of a campaign, and lists campaigns with status and audience size.

useCases.title: See who got a campaign and what happened
useCases.text: The AI lists the audience of a campaign with name, number and sent, delivered and read times, filtered by outcome such as FAILED, REPLIED or CLICKED.

useCases.title: Look up a contact by phone or read a message by id
useCases.text: The AI looks up a contact by phone number and shows name, tags, attributes, opt-in state and last activity. It can also open a message by id.

useCases.title: Add or update a contact, or send a WhatsApp message
useCases.text: The AI adds a contact, changes name, attributes, opt-in or blocked status, or sends a message or a live campaign template to one number. Sending uses credit, and you confirm first.
